title: Value of an Encoded State Run
statement: For any bit strings $ctx,w$ and any finite list $vs$ of natural numbers, running the value extraction on their encoded state yields the binary expansion of the entry of $vs$ at index $|vs|-1$, with index subtraction truncated at zero and value $0$ used when that index is out of range.
